Jade_Galio.name: Galio
Jade_Galio.lore: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions
Jade_Galio.blurb: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions

spells.name: Resolute Smite
spells.description: Galio fires a concussive blast from his eyes, slowing and dealing damage to enemies caught near the impact point.
spells.tooltip: Galio fires a concussive blast from his eyes, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies near the impact location, and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bulwark
spells.description: Galio shields an ally Champion, increasing their Armor and Magic Resistance, and restoring Galio's health each time that Champion suffers damage.
spells.tooltip: Galio shields a friendly champion or himself, shielded targets gain <scaleArmor>{{ bonusdefense }} Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>{{ bonusdefense }} Magic Resistance</scaleMR> for 4 seconds. Galio is healed for <healing>{{ totalheal }}</healing> each time the unit suffers damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Righteous Gust
spells.description: Galio claps his wings, unleashing a gust of concussive wind that damages enemies and leaves a directional draft in its wake that increases ally movement speed.
spells.tooltip: Galio unleashes a gust of concussive wind that deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>  to all enemies in its path. A directional draft remains for 5 seconds, allies gain <speed>{{ movespeedmod*100 }}% Movement Speed</speed> while moving in line with the draft.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Idol of Durand
spells.description: Galio assumes the form of a statue, taunting nearby enemies and storing concussive energy as they attack him.  Galio then bursts from his statue shell, releasing the stored energy to damage surrounding foes.
spells.tooltip:
Galio channels for 2 seconds, taunting nearby foes and taking {{ reduceddamage*100 }}% of reduced damage.

After channeling, Galio deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies, plus an additional 5% damage for each attack he suffered while channeling.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Runic Skin
passive.description: Galio converts Magic Resistance into Ability Power.
